description: Returns the chapters a book, or one chapter, is most connected to elsewhere in the Bible: chapter pairs joined by at least two verse-level cross-references (OpenBible.info), most-linked first, each with its link count and a link. 15 by default (limit 1-40). Use when the user asks which chapters a book or chapter is most connected to.

limit.description: how many results to return (1-40, default 15)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: get_book_connections
title: Connections between books
